prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1338; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the left lane of the intersection in Conroe, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 2 was eastbound and entered the intersection as the signal changed, striking the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact. Both drivers and the Passenger were interviewed at the scene, and Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash. Driver 2 stated the collision happened as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that matched the physical evidence. Scene photographs show the point of impact and the resting positions of both vehicles. Officers observed no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle, and the registered policy holder is listed as Driver 1. The extent of the damage to the rear quarter panel and the rear passenger door could not be fully determined from the impact alone, and further inspection will be needed to establish whether all of it resulted from this collision. Driver 1 was transported to a local medical facility for evaluation.
